title: mentha longifolia subsp. capensis
intro: Mentha longifolia subsp. capensis, commonly known as African pennyroyal, is a plant species within the mint family Lamiaceae, native to the Western and Eastern Cape provinces of South Africa. It has been utilized in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include relaxation, pain relief, and improved digestion, while its bioactive constituents include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Furthermore, African pennyroyal has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including menstrual cramps, indigestion, and anxiety.
